title: Maximum Average Subarray
summary: Find the highest average of any k consecutive numbers in an array.

tests.explain: The windows of length 3 sum to 10, 4, 13 and 8. The best is 6 + -2 + 9 = 13, and 13 / 3 ≈ 4.33333.
All values are negative: the best window is [-1, -2], with average -1.5.

hints: All windows have the same length k, so the window with the largest sum also has the largest average.
Recomputing every window's sum is O(n · k). Going from one window to the next, only two values change.
Sum the first k values. Then for each new index right, add nums[right] and subtract nums[right - k]. Track the best sum and divide by k once at the end.

complexity.time: O(n): each element is added once and removed once
